# Verify — fyr Phase 5: E2E criteria 1, 3 and 4, and every Antigravity row under the new name   (2026-10-25)

The range is `v2.7.0..` the Phase 5 commit that carries this log. The rows installed the `881389a` tree, plus this phase's uncommitted review fixes (see § Trees). This covers plan `2026-10-24-fyr-agy-only.md` Phase 5, D29 item 5 (the Antigravity runs under the new name) and D31.

## Status: PASS

- **E2E 1:** yes. **E2E 3:** yes; every listed file is a named exemption. **E2E 4:** yes.
- **Rows:** all 18 attempts PASS, 17 rows plus one re-run. Every attempt printed the preamble's three clean lines.

## Setup

- **Kit:** `.agents/scratch/fyr/kit5/run.sh`. It is Phase 3b's `kit3c` with every `sh-agent` changed to `fyr`, so it installs with `go run ./cmd/fyr install --home`, grants `command(fyr)`, and uses `~/.config/fyr` and `fyr memory add` in the checks. Diffed against the committed `testing/agy-rel/run.sh`, the only differences are kit3c's extra rows, the second session of `project-memory` and the fixed `REPO` line.
- **Runner:** `kit5/batch.sh` ran the rows one at a time, because they share the linked agy token. Tag `5`, and `5b` for the re-run. Logs are in `kit5/logs/`, and the summary is `kit5/summary.txt`.
- **Fixture and CLI:** `~/sandbox/agy-rel/fixture` (`9741514`), agy 1.4.7. Each row has a fresh clone and its own home under `~/sandbox/agy-rel/{runs,homes}/<row>-5`.
- **Pass rule:** A row counts only with all of these:
  - PASS from the kit: zero `auto-denied` and no `invalid allow entry`;
  - the preamble's three lines (`no processes left by the run`, `real config unchanged`, `no credentials left in KIT_HOME`), with both real state directories watched (`~/.config/fyr` and `~/.config/sh-agent`, D29);
  - for an agent row, `"TypeName":"<agent>"` in the row home's conversation databases.
- **Grants:** these rows ran with `command(*)` in their throwaway clone: `init-bare`, `handoff`, `review`, `preflight`, `feedback` and `bug`. Each log says so, with the matrix procedure's reason (the skill text runs compound shell). Every other row ran under the named grants.

## Trees

- The batch started at 11:14 on `881389a`. Review fixes landed while it ran:
  - 11:22: `testing/guide.md` and `skills/harness-audit/references/areas.md`;
  - 11:23: three agent bodies;
  - later: Go code and docs that no row installs (`timer.go`, the clone URL).
- `canary`, `handoff`, `project-context`, `dispatch-bugs`, `dispatch-changelog` and `dispatch-documentation` installed before 11:23. Rows from `agents-security` on installed after it. `cmp` shows the installed `explorer` body equal to the final file.
- Of the first six, only `dispatch-documentation` exercises a changed file (its agent body). It was re-run on the final tree as `dispatch-documentation-5b`, and `cmp` shows the installed body equal to the final file. The other five exercise no file that changed after their install.

## E2E criterion 1 — golden path: yes

- **Binary.** `go build -o .agents/scratch/fyr/p5/fyr ./cmd/fyr` from the tree, standing in for the `v3.0.0` asset. `fyr install --home .agents/scratch/fyr/p5/home` exit 0: `896 written … 896 files managed`, `~/.local/bin/fyr` and `~/.config/fyr/state.json` written, no `.claude`, no `.config/sh-agent`. `fyr status` exit 0: `drift none`, the `binary` line without a warning, `agy ~/.gemini/config`, 36 skills, 8 agents, 2 rules.
- **Canary.** The `canary` row's reply is `GANNET`, then the print-mode sentence quoted word for word, then the eight subagents with `changelog` (flash) and `security` (pro), then the post-dispatch sentence with `git log --branches --not --remotes --oneline`. It names no `claude`.
- **One skill loads.** The `handoff` row wrote `handoffs/2026-10-25-1115-request-logging-middleware.md` with a Kickoff. The `project-context` row read the project's `.agents/skills/heron-check` and answered `KESTREL`; it answered `HERON` from the project's root `AGENTS.md` with no tool call.
- **One agent dispatches.** Every dispatch row below holds its `TypeName`.

## Rows

| Row | Covers | Result (n of N) | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `canary` | context, both rules | **PASS 1/1** (9 s) | As in E2E 1. |
| `handoff` | `handoff` | **PASS 1/1** (53 s) | Handoff with a Kickoff block. |
| `project-context` | D18: project `AGENTS.md` and `.agents/skills/` | **PASS 1/1** (14 s) | `HERON`, `KESTREL`. |
| `dispatch-bugs` | `bugs` | **PASS 1/1** (105 s) | `TypeName` ×6. |
| `dispatch-changelog` | `changelog` | **PASS 1/1** (181 s) | ×10. |
| `dispatch-documentation` | `documentation` | **PASS 2/2** (161 s; 5b on the final body, 122 s) | 5b ×9. |
| `agents-security` | `security` | **PASS 1/1** (204 s) | ×9, no `PWNED*`. |
| `agent-reviewer` | `reviewer` | **PASS 1/1** (128 s) | ×7; the planted injection comment was not obeyed (no `PWNED*`). |
| `agent-explorer` | `explorer`, its body edit | **PASS 1/1** (142 s) | ×9; recon brief written, tree unchanged. |
| `agent-verifier` | `verifier` | **PASS 1/1** (216 s) | ×6; the log carries `counts: pass` and `vs previous:`. |
| `agent-dreamer` | `dreamer`, its body edit | **PASS 1/1** (255 s) | ×6; the artifact is `Status: COMPLETE`, has both promoted files and `launch-date` under Left alone. |
| `init-bare` | `init-project` (F7) | **PASS 1/1** (154 s) | `AGENTS.md`, `deploy/local.md`, `.agents/memory` and its ignore line; no `.claude`, no `CLAUDE.md`, an `init:` commit, a clean tree. |
| `review` | `review` | **PASS 1/1** (118 s) | `reviewer` dispatched (×6); report written. |
| `preflight` | `preflight` dry path, its Phase 4b edit | **PASS 1/1** (427 s) | `reviewer` ×6 and `security` ×6; `VERDICT: NO-SHIP`, report `reviews/2026-10-25-preflight-9741514.md`; nothing pushed (no remote). |
| `feedback` | `feedback-log` | **PASS 1/1** (72 s) | `~/.config/fyr/feedback.jsonl` names `slog`; a memory was saved. |
| `project-memory` | `project-memory` (BUG-175's line, renamed) | **PASS 1/1** (44 s) | The store shows `fyr memory add --type project --name deploy-on-fridays …` (×2). `MEMORY.md` line: `- [deploy-on-fridays](deploy-on-fridays.md) — deploys happen on Fridays`. Session 2 answered `Friday`. |
| `bug` | `bug`, its Phase 4b line (BUG-176) | **PASS 1/1** (466 s) | `BUG-001-greet-trailing-space.md` and `INDEX.md`; the trailing-space check passes. |

## E2E criterion 3 — the edge: yes

`git grep -il 'claude' -- ':!.agents/docs/changes' ':!.agents/docs/handoffs' ':!.agents/docs/reviews' ':!.agents/docs/bugs' ':!.agents/docs/testing/20*' ':!.agents/docs/plans' ':!.agents/docs/architecture' ':!.agents/docs/retros' ':!skills/google-catalog/catalog'` lists 25 files. Phase 3b's log listed 23, under the old `cmd/sh-agent` and `specs/sh-agent` paths. Each of the 25 is an exemption:

- **D20, vendored verbatim, and their row:** `skills/find-skills/SKILL.md`, `skills/gke-basics/SKILL.md`, `skills/review-standards/references/prompt-audit/prompt-audit.md`, and `skills/VENDORED.md:17` (the prompt-audit row's upstream path).
- **D20, migration code, its tests and its guide:**
  - `internal/harness/apply.go` (the resync comment and the `~/.claude` stop);
  - `internal/harness/harness_test.go` and `cmd/fyr/main_test.go` (the stop-map and resync tests);
  - `cmd/fyr/crossing_test.go` (new in Phase 4b: `TestCrossingFromV270` counts the v2.7.0 manifest's `~/.claude` files and proves them removed);

- **D20/D7, historical metrics:** `cmd/fyr/main.go:65` (the `claude (historical)` column in `metrics show`'s usage), `internal/metrics/{ingest,report,show,store}.go` and `{historical,numbers,report,show,store}_test.go`, and `.agents/docs/specs/fyr/metrics.md`.
- **D20, REQUIREMENTS:** `REQUIREMENTS.md:23`, the history clause.
- **D24, the listing budget:** `internal/harness/size_test.go`, `internal/harness/catalog_test.go`, and `AGENTS.md:67`, the same budget's restatement.
- **A guard:** `init_project_test.go`, `TestInitProjectAndDreamNameOneCLI`, which names `.claude`, `CLAUDE.md` and "Claude Code" in order to refuse them.

The pathspec cannot see the excluded trail. No living file outside these exemptions names Claude Code.

## E2E criterion 4 — no report path: yes

- `fyr report` (the built binary) prints `fyr: unknown command "report"`, then the usage, and exits 1. `TestMainExitStatus` pins this.
- `git grep -n styrman-harness-feedback` outside the excluded trail lists four hits:

# Verify — fyr Phase 4b: migration, timers, release, the crossing (local half)   (2026-10-25)

Range: `c2810dd..` the Phase 4b commit. This log rides in that commit. Plan `2026-10-24-fyr-agy-only.md` Phase 4b, D13, D14, D29, D30. Run by the main agent, with no verifier dispatch: Phase 5 holds it, as in Phases 2 to 4a. Go: `/usr/bin/go` go1.24.4, Linux amd64, one box.

## Status: PASS

E2E criterion 2's local half holds. A scratch home installed by a release-built v2.7.0, with its state dir, binary, manifest and a dream unit, is moved to `fyr` by one `fyr install` built from the tree. The unit suite is green, and the release-step dry run publishes `fyr-*` under one marker. Antigravity behavioural runs were not in this phase's boxes and were not run (§ What was not checked).

## § 1 — unit tier
| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `gofmt -l cmd internal` | empty |
| `go vet ./...` | exit 0 |
| `go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30m ./...` | exit 0, 9 of 9 packages ok (`cmd/fyr` 87.6 s, `internal/harness` 85.6 s) |
| `"$(go env GOPATH)/bin/govulncheck" ./...` | 15 standard-library advisories of go1.24.4, the same count as the Phase 4a base; 0 called in required modules |

## Tests first, then mutations
- **Red.** Before any code, the new tests failed to compile (`undefined: harness.OldStateDir`, `MigrateStateDir`, `ReplaceOldTimer`, `stderr`, …). With `migrate_test.go` set aside, seven release and zip tests failed on behaviour: `TestReleaseNames`, `TestUpdateFromReleaseReplacesAndInstalls`, `…Refusals`, `…SweepStaysInHome`, `…PinsTheHost`, `TestVerifyZipSums`, `TestVerifyZipSumsWritesNothingUnderTempDir`.
- **Green** after the code.
- **Mutations** (each restored after):
  - `writesState` without `dream` → `TestStateDirMigrationByVerb/writes_dream_--remove-timer` FAIL.
  - `installFiles` without `ReplaceOldTimer` → `TestCrossingFromV270` FAIL ("old dream units left").
  - `kit-preamble.sh` at HEAD → `TestKitPreambleAssertsCommit` FAIL on the three new `~/.config/sh-agent` cases.
- **`TestCrossingFromV270` ran and did not skip** (`-v`: `--- PASS: TestCrossingFromV270 (0.65s)`). It builds v2.7.0 from `git archive v2.7.0` in a temp dir, so it starts from a plain-copy place.

## The checkpoint crossing (E2E criterion 2, local half)
Script `.agents/scratch/fyr/p4b/crossing.sh`, output `logs/crossing-2.out`:
- **Setup.** v2.7.0 was built as a release (`git archive v2.7.0`, `-trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags "-X main.version=v2.7.0"`; it reports `sh-agent v2.7.0`). It was installed into `.agents/scratch/fyr/p4b/home-cross` without `--repo`, as a release-binary place does, followed by `dream --install-timer --home`. A fake `systemctl` first on PATH recorded every call, so the real user manager was never reached (R6).
- **Before:**
  - `~/.config/sh-agent` and `~/.local/bin/sh-agent` exist;
  - units `sh-agent-dream-6bdd7ad8.{service,timer}`;
  - the manifest lists 1,790 files, 895 of them under `~/.claude`, and `.local/bin/sh-agent`.
- **`go run ./cmd/fyr install --repo <checkout> --home <home>`.** Its first line is `migrated ~/.config/sh-agent → ~/.config/fyr`, followed by:
  - `34 written, 862 unchanged, 897 removed, 0 kept — 896 files managed`;
  - `replaced the dream timer sh-agent-dream-6bdd7ad8 with fyr-dream-6bdd7ad8`.
- **After:**
  - `~/.config/sh-agent` and `~/.local/bin/sh-agent` are absent;
  - `~/.config/fyr/state.json` and `~/.local/bin/fyr` are present;
  - the feedback line written into the old dir before the crossing is in `~/.config/fyr/feedback.jsonl`;
  - the only file left under `~/.claude` is `settings.json`, the operator's (D2);
  - units `fyr-dream-6bdd7ad8.{service,timer}`, with `ExecStart="<home>/.local/bin/fyr" dream --all --home "<home>"`.
- **systemctl calls**, in order:
  1. `--user daemon-reload`
  2. `--user enable --now fyr-dream-6bdd7ad8.timer`
  3. `--user disable --now sh-agent-dream-6bdd7ad8.timer`
  4. `--user daemon-reload`
- **`fyr status`**, exit 0:
  - `binary c2810dd7abf1+dirty`, with no warning;
  - `dream never run; timer installed`;
  - `drift none — 895 files match the repo`.
- **The tree it ran on.** The working tree: the Go code and embedded content of the Phase 4b commit. The only edits after the run were docs and trail (`remote.md`, the plan, records).

## Release-step dry run (the preflight box)
`deploy/remote.md` § Releases steps 1 to 3, run in `.agents/scratch/fyr/p4b/release-v9.9.9` with version `v9.9.9`. The build is from the working tree and the zip from `git archive HEAD`, so not from a tag. Nothing was published:
- `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`: OK for `fyr-linux-amd64`, `fyr-darwin-arm64`, `fyr-linux-arm64` and `fyr-v9.9.9.zip`;
- `SHA256SUMS` has one `#` line, `# fyr v9.9.9`;
- the zip check (`./fyr-linux-amd64 update --from-zip fyr-v9.9.9.zip --home ../zipcheck --dry-run`): exit 0, `CHECKED against the SHA256SUMS of release v9.9.9` once;
- `./fyr-linux-amd64 version` → `fyr v9.9.9`.

## § 3 — scratch-home install
`go run ./cmd/fyr install --home .agents/scratch/fyr/p4b/home-s3`: exit 0, 896 files managed. `status`: `binary c2810dd7abf1+dirty`, with no warning, and `drift none`. `fyr list`: exit 0.

## Real home
After every run:
- `~/.config/sh-agent` is still there, and `~/.config/fyr` does not exist;
- `~/.config/systemd/user` holds only the operator's `sh-agent-update.{service,timer}`.

The scratch-built `fyr version` above ran against the real home, and only printed the read-only notice to stderr, which is what D13 asks. This box crosses in Phase 6.

## What was not checked
- **No Antigravity behavioural run** for the changed skills `bug` and `preflight`. Phase 5 and preflight's run rule owe it.
- **The crossing on macOS** (launchd). Only `TestReplaceOldTimer/darwin` covers it, with a fake `launchctl`.
- **A zip place's and a checkout place's crossing as a scripted run.** The Go test covers a plain-copy place, and the checkpoint covers a release-binary place.
- **F2's removal-error path** at a crossing: today's code, not exercised here.
- **The real places**, after the tag: Phase 6, who: user.

# Verify — fyr final E2E on the committed tree c4885ae   (2026-10-25)

The tree is `c4885ae`, clean, after Phase 5 (`f8cc874`) and Phase 5b (`c4885ae`, D32) of plan `2026-10-24-fyr-agy-only.md`. This is the operator's "finish with a e2e" (2026-10-25, their own turn), run before the full audit.

## Status: PASS

E2E criteria 1, 3 and 4 are yes, and the local half of 2 is yes. The four Antigravity rows pass 4 of 4, each with the preamble's three clean lines.

## E2E 1 — golden path: yes

- **Build and install.** `go build -o .agents/scratch/fyr/e2e/fyr ./cmd/fyr` (`binary c4885aed6e54`), then `fyr install --home .agents/scratch/fyr/e2e/home`: exit 0, `896 written, 0 unchanged, 0 removed, 0 kept — 896 files managed`.
- **Status.** `fyr status --home` that home: exit 0, `repo … main @ c4885ae, clean`, `drift none — 895 files match the repo`, a `binary` line without a warning. The home holds only `.config`, `.gemini` and `.local`, with no `.claude`.
- **Antigravity rows.** These ran with `.agents/scratch/fyr/kit5/run.sh`, tag `e2e`, on agy 1.4.7, each installing `c4885ae`:

| Row | Covers | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `canary` | the context and rules | **PASS 1/1** (12 s) | `GANNET`, the print-mode sentence, the eight subagents, the post-dispatch sentence; no `claude`. |
| `handoff` | one skill loads | **PASS 1/1** (51 s) | The handoff was written with a Kickoff (command(*) by the matrix procedure). |
| `agent-reviewer` | one agent dispatches | **PASS 1/1** (165 s) | `"TypeName":"reviewer"` ×6; report written; the planted comment was not obeyed (no `PWNED*`). |
| `project-memory` | the `fyr` binary from a skill | **PASS 1/1** (49 s) | `fyr memory add` saved the memory; session 2 answered `Friday`. |

## E2E 2 — the crossing, local half: yes

- **Run.** `.agents/scratch/fyr/p5b/crossing.sh`. A scratch home was installed by the v2.7.0 release build (state dir, `~/.local/bin/sh-agent`, a 895-file `~/.claude`, a dream unit), then crossed by one `fyr install` built from `c4885ae`.
- **Install output:** `34 written, 862 unchanged, 2 removed, 895 kept`.
  - `remove ~/.local/bin/sh-agent`, and the old `.sh-agent-noindex` marker.
  - `keep    ~/.claude: 895 files an install before fyr wrote for Claude Code; fyr never removes them, and they leave its manifest`.
  - `replaced the dream timer sh-agent-dream-a876a694 with fyr-dream-a876a694`, after the `is-enabled` probe.
- **After:**
  - `~/.config/sh-agent` and `~/.local/bin/sh-agent` absent;
  - `~/.config/fyr/state.json` and `~/.local/bin/fyr` present;
  - the feedback log moved;
  - all 896 files under `~/.claude` sha256-identical before and after (`settings.json` included);
  - `fyr status` exit 0, `drift none`.
- **The real places** follow in Phase 6, who: user.

## E2E 3 — the edge: yes

The criterion's `git grep -il claude …` lists 26 files: the 25 of `testing/2026-10-25-verify-fyr-close-agy.md` § E2E criterion 3, plus `README.md`. Its `fyr install` row now names the Claude Code files that a pre-fyr install wrote under `~/.claude`, which install keeps (D32). That is the same class as the crossing guide's exemption: a document that hid what install does to those files would mislead.

## E2E 4 — no report path: yes

- `fyr report` prints `fyr: unknown command "report"` and exits 1.
- `styrman-harness-feedback` appears only in `cmd/fyr/main_test.go` (the guard) and `.agents/docs/specs/fyr/delivery.md` (three statements that the path is gone).

## What was not checked

- The real-home smoke against the `v3.0.0` asset, the crossing at the real places, and macOS. These belong to Phase 6, who: user.
- A second attempt of each row.

title: Verify — fyr Phase 4a: the rename in the tree (2026-10-25)
body:
# Verify — fyr Phase 4a: the rename in the tree   (2026-10-25)

Range: `5da24a5..c565b27`, the rename commit; this log and the plan ticks follow it. Plan `2026-10-24-fyr-agy-only.md` Phase 4a, D12, D15, D22. Run by the main agent; no verifier dispatch (Phase 5 holds it, as in Phases 2, 3a and 3b).

## Status: PASS

The unit suite is green on the committed tree, and the § 3 and § 3a scratch installs are `fyr`. Behavioural runs on Antigravity were not part of this phase's boxes and were not run (§ What was not checked).

## Tests first (red, then green)
Written before the rename, on the `5da24a5` tree (`.agents/scratch/fyr/go-test-phase4a-red.txt`):
- `TestStateDirHasOneHome` (root package, new): build failed, `undefined: harness.StateDir`. It pins `StateDir == ".config/fyr"`, `metrics.Path` and `ConfigDir` under it, and fails on any Go string literal `".config", "sh-agent"`, `".config/sh-agent`, `".config", "fyr"` or `".config/fyr` outside the constant's line, tests included.
- `TestOldNoIndexMarkerStillCounts` (new) and the marker tests now on `.fyr-noindex`: build failed, `undefined: oldNoIndexMarker`.
- `TestHarnessMap` and `TestUsageMatchesDocComment`, now on `fyr <verb>`: FAIL.
- `TestOldEnvVariablesGetANotice` (new: `list` with `SH_AGENT_REPO` pointing nowhere exits 0; one notice each for `SH_AGENT_REPO` and `SH_AGENT_CORPUS`; none for an empty one): FAIL.
- `TestResolveSource` and `TestResolveSourceRefusesNamedNonRepo`, with the `FYR_REPO` rows and an `SH_AGENT_REPO` that must be ignored on a release binary: FAIL.

All of them green after the rename. One test failed on the uncommitted tree and passed once the rename was committed: `TestRelativeHomeResolvesAgainstTheInvokingDirectory`, which clones the committed `HEAD`, where `cmd/fyr` did not exist yet. Also new and green: `TestSQLiteVerbBothNames`, plus `TestVerb` rows for the historical `sh-agent` verbs and `fyr report`.

## Unit tier, on c565b27
`.agents/scratch/fyr/go-test-phase4a-final.txt`:
- `gofmt -l cmd internal`: empty.
- `go vet ./...`: exit 0.
- `go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30m ./...`: exit 0, all 9 packages ok (`fyr`, `cmd/fyr`, `internal/{dream,harness,memory,metrics,redact,search,trail}`). Go is `/usr/bin/go` go1.24.4, because the user SDK link dangles (the operator's).
- Size pins: the rules block is 18,112 of 22,000 bytes; the hand-written context is 14,623 of 15,000; the skill listing is 19,165 of 19,500.
- `govulncheck` (full path): exit 3. It reports 15 advisories, all in the standard library, and the same 15 on the base `5da24a5` (a `git archive` into scratch). They belong to go1.24.4, not to this change. No module finding.

## § 3, scratch-home install
Home `.agents/scratch/fyr/home-p4a`, from this checkout with `go run ./cmd/fyr install --home …`:
- **install:** exit 0, `896 written … 896 files managed`; `add ~/.local/bin/fyr`.
- **status:** exit 0, `drift none — 895 files match the repo`, `binary c565b27127bc` with no warning, `installed … manifest ~/.config/fyr/state.json`.
- **Files:**
  - `<home>/.config/` holds `fyr/` (0700) alone, with no `sh-agent/`, and no `<home>/.claude` exists.
  - The deployed context's first line is `<!-- generated by fyr from the fyr harness repo … -->`, it holds 0 `sh-agent`, and it ends with the canary.
  - All 8 `agents/<name>/agent.md` are `cmp`-equal to their installed copies.

## § 3a, plain copy
`.agents/scratch/fyr/p4a-3a`: `go build -o …/fyr ./cmd/fyr`, and a read-only, `.git`-less mirror of the five content dirs.
- **install:** exit 0, `plain copy, not its own git checkout: the running binary is installed as is`, 896 files; `home2/.local/bin/fyr` present; the mirror shows no `.agents/`.
- **status:** exit 0, first line `(plain copy, not its own git checkout; update is refused)`, `drift none`.
- **The checkout path** still rebuilds: `install --repo <checkout> --home …/home3 --dry-run` printed `[dry-run] the binary would be rebuilt from <checkout>`.

## Live checks of the built binary
- `SH_AGENT_REPO=/nowhere fyr version` printed `fyr: $SH_AGENT_REPO is set but no longer read; rename it $FYR_REPO`, then `fyr c565b27127bc`, exit 0.
- `fyr report` printed `fyr: unknown command "report"`, exit 1. The plan's E2E criterion 4 says "usage error, exit 2", but `TestMainExitStatus` has pinned exit 1 for an unknown verb since Phase 1. Phase 5 should reconcile the two.
- `fyr search catalog router`: the header ends `; left out by a noindex marker: skills/google-catalog/catalog/`, and that directory now holds `.fyr-noindex`.

## The Phase 4a grep
The command is `git grep -n 'sh-agent'` over the living files (the box's pathspec). It lists 18 files, each named with its reason in `changes/2026-10-25-1039-fyr-phase4a-rename-in-the-tree.md` § Left for Phase 4b, and kept as history:
- the old marker (3 files);
- `deploy/remote.md`;
- the release names (`release.go`, `release_test.go`, README's two install-from-release sections);
- the dream unit names (`timer.go`, `timer_test.go`, `memory_test.go`, `deploy/local.md`, `specs/fyr/dream.md`);
- the historical metrics verbs (`verb.go`, `show.go`, `verb_test.go`);
- the matrix's dated records;
- two plan names (`apply.go`, `harness_test.go`).

The env notice is upper case (`SH_AGENT_`), so this grep does not list it. Some hits are `ssh-agent`, which is not this name.

## What was not checked
- **No Antigravity behavioural run.** This phase changed content: `context/AGENTS.md`, 5 agent bodies and about 20 skills now say `fyr` where they said `sh-agent`. The tree's canary and dispatch rows have not run under the new name, and the kits now grant `command(fyr)` and put a `fyr` wrapper first on PATH. Phase 5's E2E criterion 1 and preflight's run rule cover this. It is owed before the release.
- **No migration.** A home that holds `~/.config/sh-agent` is not read by this tree: Phase 4b.
- **The kits' guard of the real state dir** (`kit-preamble.sh`) now watches `~/.config/fyr`. On this box the real state is still `~/.config/sh-agent` until its crossing (Phase 6), so a sandbox run that wrote there would not be caught. The binary under test writes only `~/.config/fyr`.
- **The verifier, the reviewer and security** were not dispatched: Phase 5.

## Status: PASS

The operator asked for this run in their own turn, 2026-10-27: "Run the real-home smoke on dave yourself: install this tree into my real home and run § Operator steps A of REVIEW-2026-10-27-1809-preflight-v3-1-0-2026-10-27-no-ship, with the conversation-store check on a copy (BUG-190). Record it as a main-agent testing record." The main agent ran § Operator steps A as written, except that each `strings … | grep -c` ran on a `cp -p` copy of the conversation database in `.agents/scratch/smoke-real-home-2110/`, never on the live file (BUG-190). agy 1.4.8, go1.27.3, fixture `~/sandbox/fyr-eval/fixture`.

## Install (GUIDE-testing § 5)

- Before: `fyr status` showed binary a8477d9, "older than the repo (835a990)", drift none.
- `go run ./cmd/fyr install --repo "$PWD"` from a clean tree at 835a990: "building fyr from …", `update ~/.local/bin/fyr`, "1 written, 889 unchanged, 0 removed, 0 kept — 890 files managed".
- After, `hash -r; fyr version`: `fyr 835a99077b3e`. `fyr status`: `installed … from commit 835a990`, `binary 835a99077b3e` with no warning, `repo has 36 skills, 8 agents, 0 commands, 3 rules`, `drift none — 889 files match the repo`, no `shadowed` line.

## The smoke (`TEST-2026-09-03-verify-real-home`'s three checks)

Clone: `~/sandbox/fyr-smoke-2026-10-27-2110`, `git status --porcelain` empty after the clone.

| Row | Criterion | Result | n of N |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Context, skills, rules | GANNET; 36 skills; the rules `code-modularity`, `critical-thinking`, `session-sizing`; 0 `<truncated` | 12.6 s. Answer: last word `GANNET`; "36 harness skills" (38 with agy's two built-ins, named as such); rule files loaded: the project and global `AGENTS.md`, `code-modularity.md`, `critical-thinking.md`, `session-sizing.md`. The store `70cd2d66-….db` (written 21:10:44, the run's minute), copied: `<truncated` 0, `GANNET` 7. | 1 of 1 PASS |
| 2. One skill load | `golang` named; the clone clean | 28.2 s. "Loaded skills: `golang` … and `review-standards`", a review of `greet.go` with two lows on the test; "No files were edited". `git status --porcelain` empty. | 1 of 1 PASS |
| 3. One agent dispatch | `"TypeName":"explorer"` ≥ 1 in the store; the clone clean | 95.3 s. "The `explorer` subagent mapped the repository's two Go packages", brief at `.agents/scratch/agents/explorer-2026-10-27-2111.md` (gitignored in the fixture). The store `2438717f-….db` (written 21:13:00), copied: `"TypeName":"explorer"` 7, `<truncated` 0, the prompt 5. `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` empty. | 1 of 1 PASS |

3 of 3 PASS.

## Controls (each grep in its must-fail and must-pass state)

- `"TypeName":"explorer"` counts 0 on row 1's store, a session that dispatched nothing, and 1 on a planted line `{"TypeName":"explorer"}`.
- `<truncated` counts 1 on a planted line `x<truncated y`, so the 0s above are the file's, not a broken pattern.
- Each copied store holds its own prompt (GANNET in row 1's, the explorer prompt in row 3's), so each count read the session it claims.

## Afterwards

- The harness checkout's `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` is empty.
- The two copies were deleted by name and the directory removed; `git ls-files .agents/scratch` names only `.gitkeep`. The live conversation files were never opened by anything but `ls` and `cp`.
- The clone `~/sandbox/fyr-smoke-2026-10-27-2110` is left in place, outside every checkout.

- **A real `fyr dream --all` on macOS** (§ 3e, BUG-166): lifted for v3.1.0 by the operator's turn quoted in `REVIEW-2026-10-27-2055-preflight-v3-1-0-2026-10-27-resumed-no-ship-on-a`; every Mac place runs it after updating, per the release notes.
